response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on software development and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — he authored a test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), ran CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure, and taught TDD/Selenium courses. However, the role is a people-leadership position, and the resume shows no evidence of the required 2 years of people management or formal team leadership: every title is an individual-contributor role (Senior/Staff Software Engineer), with no reports, performance management, hiring, or roadmap-ownership signals. Mobile-platform exposure is thin (a short stint maintaining iOS/Apple TV apps in 2015–16) and there is no indication of leading organizational change. He could be a strong fit for a senior/staff IC role on an engineering-productivity team, but as a Level II Manager hire he would be an unproven first-time manager stepping into a large-scope org.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tools portfolio: test runner, assertion library, CI/CD and build infrastructure
15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, embedded, low-latency services and desktop IDE tooling
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, code katas, refactoring dojos and multi-module courses
concerns: No documented people-management experience; misses the 2-year minimum
No evidence of technical leadership scope such as roadmap ownership or cross-team alignment
Minimal and dated mobile-platform experience; no organizational-change leadership

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure depth
Limited mobile ecosystem and formal tech-lead scope
